snippet.title: B-Prison Unchain - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/b-prison-unchain/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4395030/BPrison_Unchain/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this turn-based RPG, play as Misa, the supposedly strongest soldier in the Demon Realm, as she hunts down the legendary incubus Asmodeus. Battle through the succubi prison, recruit allies, and survive nasty traps, but beware! The enemies sent after you have plenty of tricks to slow you down!
